The correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is held on the right side.

**__Detailed Explanation:__**

__
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/499cf466b564e568934f9eaeee2dfd8d5b2904f1c6362c7e5435cf3e43e7d326.png] " the fifth number of the given image is ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97f654dc03cf2bc7f474b8fd0b334266db55ce5bdd992b725da8b5142d21100e.png] ' and the correct mirror image of this number is ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61cf7c23d3a97f7c64da4918c0cb9506c39a1453dd69da6aa38ed0ecc6962f22.png] ' but it is not wrongly given in Option 1 and Option 3 so it is eliminated.
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/499cf466b564e568934f9eaeee2dfd8d5b2904f1c6362c7e5435cf3e43e7d326.png] " the first letter of the given image is ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e112ab0d7abc2837d1868fd150f5fedcfc616e64a188414dffd0119f596cb2d.png] ' and the correct mirror image of this alphabet is ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/196f6fba9ca8ebaefa0339287e26a523eeff10ee989b320efab0290fe02917f9.png] ' but it is wrongly given in Option 4 so it is eliminated.
